newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones plans announcement on market index.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones plans announcement on market index.

text.p: Dow Jones & Co Inc said Thursday it will hold a press conference late this morning "to make a major announcement involving its Dow Jones Industrial Average stock market index."
In a statement, Dow Jones said it will hold a press conference at 1100 EDT/1500 GMT.

The company did not disclose any specifics regarding the planned annnouncement but it has said in recent weeks that it was considering various exchanges' plans to license the average for derivatives products.
